title: Trust, Security & Compliance | Purview Services
description: Purview operates in environments where quality, security, privacy, availability and traceability matter.
lede: Purview operates in environments where quality, security, privacy, availability and traceability matter. This page brings the assurance framework together for procurement and technology decision-makers.

blocks.text: The assurance framework, in one place.
Defined delivery processes, quality gates, engineering reviews, change control and continuous improvement.
Access governance, secure development, risk assessments, incident response and client-specific security obligations.
Service continuity planning, escalation paths, monitoring, backup and recovery responsibilities aligned to contract scope.
Human oversight, evaluation criteria, auditability, model/data controls and appropriate security boundaries.
Policies, applicable certificates, insurance, compliance statements and relevant references for qualified clients.
Let’s discuss the outcome you need.
